[[Pakhtakor Tashkent FK|Pakhtakor Tashkent]] were the defending champions from the 2021 campaign, and successfully defended their title. This season, 14 clubs took part. The tournament was traditionally held according to the "spring-autumn" system. In July, the league had a summer break between the first and second rounds. The championship was held in 26 rounds. Matches were held in the evening on the last days of the week (Friday, Saturday and Sunday).
